text_block_list.text:
Now, Мэйсё Дото. Would you read
page
thirty-six of the textbook for us?
text_block_list.name: Teacher A

text_block_list.text:
Um... For the first time in its history, the
Enka
Fest is said to be postponed this
year, as the star
unexpectedly strained
their... back?!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Th-this isn't the textbook! Oh no, I'm so
s-sorry
about this!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: I-it should be th-this one... Huh?!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Oh no, this is the screenplay Opera O
gave me!
B-but my textbook... isn't
here?!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I'm r-really sorry, but... I must have
forgotten to
bring it with me!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото remorsefully shares a
textbook with
a classmate for the rest of
the day.
